blocks.note: Choose a for directed motion and en for static location while respecting lexical and regional constraints.
Complete established adverbial expressions with a or en as lexical units rather than translating an English preposition.
Use desde when the point of origin or starting boundary is profiled, and de for source, composition, and fixed pairings.
Distinguish para as destination or intended endpoint from por as cause, route, exchange, means, or motive.
Contrast approximate passage through time or place with por against deadlines, destinations, and projected endpoints with para.
Learn fixed por and para expressions together with the governing verbs, adjectives, and nouns that select them.
Resolve person-focused por and para from viewpoint, beneficiary, motive, substitution, and personal judgment.
Separate literal position with delante de or debajo de from the more abstract, formal, or figurative uses of ante and bajo.
Interpret compact written tras as temporal después de or spatial detrás de only where the meaning permits the replacement.
Choose among the remaining simple prepositions by relation: accompaniment, opposition, extent, direction, boundary, means, dependence, absence, or topic.
Produce only the unambiguous prepositional phrases that survived the corpus judgment gate.
Treat a verb and its governed preposition as a lexical frame, especially before an infinitive or subordinate clause.
